truthBoundary: Read-only evidence snapshot. Repository presence is not proof of application; Supabase migration history is not proof of authenticated E2E or VERIFIED_LIVE. Non-exact migration names remain REVIEW_REQUIRED.

reconciliation.note: Timestamp or naming divergence may represent equivalent migrations, rebased migrations, or unapplied repository files. No equivalence is asserted without SQL checksum/content evidence.

objectLevelProductionEvidence.truthBoundary: Read-only pg_catalog, information_schema, pg_policies, and role grants from Supabase project cxhulvwkagzufbjsdwwu compared with repository migration SQL at main revision 668cee1aef1e61b487b8fc7ed2fb4b87aa0dcccb.
objectLevelProductionEvidence.method: All 20 repository migrations without exact production migration-name matches were parsed for declared public relations, functions, exact policy names, and explicit table grant/revoke effects. Object presence is production evidence but is not SQL equivalence.
objectLevelProductionEvidence.caveat: No migration is declared equivalent or safely deployable from object presence alone. Renamed/rebased migrations, later replacement migrations, altered function bodies, policy expressions, constraints, triggers, and data effects require SQL-definition or checksum reconciliation.
